correctness.rationale: For connected simple unicyclic graph with m=|E|=|V|, 3<=ell<=m, Walsh edge characters χ_uv=x_u x_v span W_G. Translation-averaging any projection produces unique Fourier projection and norm E|Σχ_e|; prior Defant et al. Theorem 3.1 transfers equality to absolute projection constant. Vertex→edge signs have exactly one constraint ∏_{cycle}η=+1 and uniform fibers, so λ = E|S_m| + E(|S_m|∏_{i<=ell}η_i). For odd ell global sign reversal kills correction. Even ell=2k uses Walsh Laplacian L|S| and conditional Krawtchouk coefficient (−1)^k binom(floor(m/2),k)/binom(m,2k), yielding Δ=(−1)^(k−1) q_m/(2k−1)*binom(floor(m/2),k)/binom(m,2k). Stirling gives fixed-ell asymptotic m^(1/2-k). Independently enumerated C4 and C6 vertex sign configurations giving λ=1 and 9/4, which is consistent with source checker for m<=11 but not an infinite proof.
